=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- .claude/hooks/pr_merge_status_guard.py: `_push_targets`, `refspecs = positionals[1:] if positionals else []` | severity=critical | confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, google_gemini-3_8-flash, openai_gpt-6-luna, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, z-ai_glm-5_2]
  PROBLEM: The parser drops the first refspec when the remote is supplied with `--repo` or omitted, so it can check the checkout branch instead of the push destination.
  WHY: A push to a merged destination can bypass the guard; the highest reported severity is critical (BLOCKER), while openai_gpt-6-luna rated it major.
- .claude/hooks/pr_merge_status_guard.py: `_branch_ref` | severity=critical | confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, google_gemini-3_8-flash, openai_gpt-6-luna, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, z-ai_glm-5_2]
  PROBLEM: A bare `HEAD` push is treated as targeting a branch literally named `HEAD` instead of resolving the current branch.
  WHY: The PR lookup misses the actual branch's merged PR and allows the push; the highest reported severity is critical (BLOCKER), while openai_gpt-6-luna rated it major.
- .claude/hooks/pr_merge_status_guard.py: `_shell_segments_with_operators`, `_SHELL_PUNCTUATION_CHARS = ";&|\n<>"`, and `_push_targets` positional parsing | severity=critical | confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, google_gemini-3_8-flash, openai_gpt-6-luna, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, z-ai_glm-5_2]
  PROBLEM: File-descriptor redirections leave the descriptor number, such as `2` in `2>&1`, among Git arguments where it is treated as a refspec.
  WHY: The spurious refspec can cause a fallback to the session checkout and a false block; it can also cause an unnecessary PR lookup or false block for branch `2`. The highest reported severity is critical (BLOCKER), while openai_gpt-6-luna, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, and z-ai_glm-5_2 rated it major.
- .claude/hooks/pr_merge_status_guard.py: `_guarded_git_invocations`, `if operator not in ("", "&&", ";", "\n"): working_directory = None` | severity=critical | confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, google_gemini-3_8-flash, openai_gpt-6-luna, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, z-ai_glm-5_2]
  PROBLEM: The parser clears the resolved worktree after `||`, even when the operator guards only an `exit` command before the push.
  WHY: The push is then evaluated against the session checkout and can be falsely blocked or allowed based on the wrong branch; the highest reported severity is critical (BLOCKER), while the other reviewers rated it major.
- .claude/hooks/pr_merge_status_guard.py: `_guarded_git_invocations`, assignment regex `re.match(r"^[A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_]*=", tokens[index])`; also in `git_subcommands` at line 348 | severity=high | confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, google_gemini-3_8-flash, openai_gpt-6-luna, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, z-ai_glm-5_2]
  PROBLEM: The assignment recognizer does not recognize Bash append assignments such as `NAME+=value`, so the guarded Git command can be missed.
  WHY: The prefilter may return before guard evaluation; the highest reported severity is high (MAJOR), while z-ai_glm-5_2 rated it NIT.
- .claude/hooks/pr_merge_status_guard.py: `_evaluate_bash`, `_run(["git", "rev-parse", ...])` discarding stdout; `_push_targets`, source validation `re.fullmatch(r"[A-Za-z0-9_./-]+|HEAD", source) | severity=high | confidence=[4]
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, google_gemini-3_8-flash, qwen_qwen3_7-plus]
  PROBLEM: The resolved source commit SHA is discarded and a leading-dash source can remain uncanonicalized for the ancestry check.
  WHY: Git can interpret the raw source as an option, causing the ancestry check to fail and the guard to allow a push; these reviewers reported major severity.
- .claude/hooks/pr_merge_status_guard.py: `_push_targets`, `re.fullmatch(r"[A-Za-z0-9_./-]+|HEAD", source) | severity=high | confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, google_gemini-3_8-flash, openai_gpt-6-luna, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, z-ai_glm-5_2]
  PROBLEM: The source-ref validation rejects valid Git revision expressions containing operators such as `~` or `^`.
  WHY: The evaluator falls back to checking the session checkout rather than the pushed source, which can skip the guard for the actual commit; the highest reported severity is high (MAJOR), while z-ai_glm-5_2 rated it NIT.
- .claude/hooks/pr_merge_status_guard.py: `_literal_guard_path`, `if shell_cd and not os.path.isabs(path) and os.environ.get("CDPATH") and not path.startswith(("./", "../")) | severity=high | confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, google_gemini-3_8-flash, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, z-ai_glm-5_2]
  PROBLEM: The CDPATH check does not exempt bare `.` or `..`, so those paths can be treated as unresolved when CDPATH is set.
  WHY: A subsequent push falls back to the session checkout instead of using the resolved worktree; the highest reported severity is high (MAJOR), while z-ai_glm-5_2 rated it NIT.
- .claude/hooks/pr_merge_status_guard.py: `_evaluate_bash`, the loop over targets calling `_request_confirmation` from `_unreachable_outcome` | severity=high | confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, google_gemini-3_8-flash, openai_gpt-6-luna, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, z-ai_glm-5_2]
  PROBLEM: Multiple unreachable targets, or a combination of an unreachable target and a blocked target, can produce multiple or contradictory hook responses.
  WHY: Multiple JSON objects, or confirmation JSON alongside a block result, violate the PreToolUse hook's single-response protocol.
- .claude/hooks/pr_merge_status_guard.py: `_evaluate_bash`, `if code != 0: _warn(...); target = _GuardTarget(checkout, {}, "", "HEAD", True)` | severity=high | confidence=[4]
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, google_gemini-3_8-flash, openai_gpt-6-luna, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, z-ai_glm-5_2]
  PROBLEM: When source-ref resolution fails in a worktree, the evaluator resets the target to the session checkout.
  WHY: The hook may block an unrelated worktree push based on the session checkout's branch; severity was consistently reported as major.
- .claude/hooks/pr_merge_status_guard.py: `_push_targets`, option abbreviation whitelist `("--pu", "--push-o", "--rep", "--rece", "--e")` | severity=low | confidence=[4]
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, google_gemini-3_8-flash, qwen_qwen3_7-plus]
  PROBLEM: The option scanner does not recognize some valid Git long-option abbreviations, including `--push-op` and `--rec`.
  WHY: Such options cause uncertain parsing and fallback to checking the session checkout instead of resolving the worktree destination.

=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

=== CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===
- requirement: "Acceptance: tests in `tests/test_pr_merge_status_guard.py` cover all of these" and the reported missing cases for bare `HEAD`, `--repo`-supplied remote, redirections, and `cd <worktree> || exit 1` chains.
  expected_change_site: tests/test_pr_merge_status_guard.py
  confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, z-ai_glm-5_2]
  EVIDENCE: Both reviewers report that existing acceptance scenarios are covered but tests for `git push origin HEAD`, `git push --repo origin HEAD:feature/x`, redirections such as `2>&1`, and `cd <worktree> || exit 1; git push ...` are missing.
- requirement: "Resolve the effective repository for each guarded git command: the last `cd <path>` before it in the same command line, `git -C <path>`, or `GIT_DIR` / `GIT_WORK_TREE` prefixes."
  expected_change_site: .claude/hooks/pr_merge_status_guard.py, _push_targets and _guarded_git_invocations
  confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [qwen_qwen3_7-plus]
  EVIDENCE: The parser mishandles `--repo`, file-descriptor redirections, `||`, and append assignments, and the reviewer reports no tests covering these cases.
- requirement: "For `git push <remote> HEAD:<ref>` or `<src>:<ref>`, check the **target ref** (`<ref>`) for a merged PR with no open PR, not the local branch name."
  expected_change_site: .claude/hooks/pr_merge_status_guard.py, _push_targets and _branch_ref
  confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [qwen_qwen3_7-plus, z-ai_glm-5_2]
  EVIDENCE: `_branch_ref("HEAD")` returns the literal branch name `"HEAD"` instead of resolving the current branch; neither reviewer found a test for `git push origin HEAD` without an explicit destination branch.
- requirement: "If the directory cannot be resolved (a variable, a subshell), keep today's behaviour for that command and log a warning."
  expected_change_site: .claude/hooks/pr_merge_status_guard.py, `_guarded_git_invocations` and `git_subcommands`
  confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_2]
  EVIDENCE: Parenthesized subshells are not parsed as shell separators, and Git is not detected when `(` is the first token; the guarded command can return early or use the session checkout without the required fallback warning.

=== END CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===

=== FINDINGS FROM deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro ===
- .claude/hooks/pr_merge_status_guard.py (PR diff new code): `_push_targets`, `refspecs = positionals[1:] if positionals else []` | severity=BLOCKER | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: When `--repo origin` is used or the remote is omitted, the first positional is a refspec, not the remote, so the destination is dropped.
  WHY: The merged destination is not checked and the push can bypass the guard.
- .claude/hooks/pr_merge_status_guard.py (PR diff new code): `_branch_ref`, the regex returns `"HEAD"` as a branch name; `_evaluate_bash`, `target.branch or current_branch(target.cwd)` selects the literal `"HEAD"` string | severity=BLOCKER | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: A bare `HEAD` push is looked up as a PR for branch `HEAD` instead of the checked-out branch.
  WHY: The actual merged branch is never checked, so the push is allowed.
- .claude/hooks/pr_merge_status_guard.py (PR diff new code): `_shell_segments_with_operators`, `_SHELL_PUNCTUATION_CHARS = ";&|\n<>"`, and `_push_targets` positional parsing | severity=BLOCKER | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: File-descriptor redirections leave tokens such as `2` among push arguments, where they become spurious refspecs.
  WHY: Resolution of the spurious refspec can fall back to the session checkout and falsely block the worktree push.
- .claude/hooks/pr_merge_status_guard.py (PR diff new code): `_guarded_git_invocations`, `if operator not in ("", "&&", ";", "\n"): working_directory = None` | severity=BLOCKER | confidence=5

  WHY: A subsequent worktree push is checked against the session checkout and can be falsely blocked.
